unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 2 - Read Like a Persuader - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Three pictures held all term: flag (claim), magnifier (prove), megaphone (sell). Weeks 1-5 final piece: a published persuasive text on an issue from The Last Bear.

lessons.title: Inside a Persuasive Text
lessons.focus: Highlight claim, proof and sell in a mentor text, then judge its best line. Critical feature: every sentence has a job. Fun activity: highlighting.

lessons.title: Words with Power
lessons.focus: Choose emotive and precise words, and build word families with suffixes. Critical feature: the word changes how the reader feels, but it must stay true. Retrieves: Week 1 modality.

lessons.title: Prove It
lessons.focus: Pick the strongest evidence for a claim from fact cards and write a claim-prove-sell paragraph. Critical feature: evidence must match the claim and come from someone who would know. Retrieves: Term 3 appositives (Dr Lee, a scientist, says).

lessons.title: Fair or Sneaky?
lessons.focus: Spot unfair persuasion (exaggeration, everyone-does-it, name-calling) and rewrite it fairly. Critical feature: strong is not the same as true.
